meta.note: Values sampled from the DesignCode UI kit spec sheets (Color Styles Light/Dark/Button, Gradients, Angular Gradients) and dashboard screenshots; type sizes, shadows and spacing measured from renders.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background, painted under the mood backdrop. Light from the Color buttons spec page; dark is the navy of the Skyscape screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Opaque card or list row when there is no backdrop to blur (the light course lesson rows, the navy dashboard panels).

tokens.name: mood-1
tokens.usage: Backdrop glow, top of the page (the blue wash in the hero). Only inside the backdrop, never behind text directly.

tokens.name: mood-2
tokens.usage: Backdrop glow, lower left (the rose wash in light; violet in dark).

tokens.name: mood-3
tokens.usage: Backdrop glow, lower right (lavender in light, deep navy in dark).

tokens.name: fg-primary
tokens.usage: Foreground Primary: headings, names, values. On page, surface and container-bg in every theme.

tokens.name: fg-secondary
tokens.usage: Foreground Secondary: body copy and descriptions, on page, surface and container-bg.

tokens.name: fg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Foreground Tertiary: timestamps, axis labels, placeholders. Light raised from the kit's 50% to 55% black to reach 4.7:1 on page; dark keeps the kit value and passes. On light glass over a bright backdrop, check it stays legible.

tokens.name: container-bg
tokens.usage: Container Background: the glass fill of cards, menus, inputs and segmented controls; always with blur-glass behind it.

tokens.name: container-border
tokens.usage: Container Border: the 1px edge of every glass container and glass button. Decorative, not a control boundary on its own.

tokens.name: container-divider
tokens.usage: Container Divider: hairlines between rows inside a container (the source draws it as a fading radial line).

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: The light catch on glass cards: a diagonal fade from the top-left corner to transparent, layered over container-bg. Never a fill on its own.

tokens.name: glass-tint-blue
tokens.usage: Transparent blue wash in tinted cards (Card tint accent, cool). Text stays fg-primary / fg-secondary on it.

tokens.name: glass-tint-violet
tokens.usage: Transparent violet wash in tinted cards (Card tint accent, violet).

tokens.name: glass-tint-rose
tokens.usage: Transparent rose wash in tinted cards (Card tint rose, warm).

tokens.name: glass-tint-teal
tokens.usage: Transparent teal wash in tinted cards (Card tint cool).

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: Button: fills that carry a button-fg label — primary buttons, checked checkboxes, toggle tracks, slider fill, the current page. White on it is 5.3:1 (light) and 4.8:1 (dark). Deepened from the kit's #007aff / #3395ff so labels pass AA. For blue text, icons and rings use button-text.

tokens.name: button-hover
tokens.usage: Button Hover: hover and pressed fill of the primary color button; ghost hover border and text.

tokens.name: button-fg
tokens.usage: Button Foreground: label and icon on button and button-hover fills.

tokens.name: button-text
tokens.usage: The accent as text, icons, rings and thin marks on page and glass: ghost and tinted buttons, links, the selected segment's label ('Week'), sort arrows, radio rings, selection bars, unread dots. 4.8:1 on the light page (same as button); in dark it is the kit's lighter #3395ff, 6.6:1 on page. Never put button-fg text on it.

tokens.name: button-selected
tokens.usage: Button Selected: the 2px ring of a selected or toggled control.

tokens.name: button-inactive
tokens.usage: Button Inactive: disabled fill and ghost-inactive border/text. Inactive labels are intentionally low contrast.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring 2px outside the control. 4.8:1 on the light page, 6.6:1 on the dark page.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed-lesson check. As an icon on white it is 2.9:1 (source kept): always pair it with a label or a check shape.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Field errors: the error message text and the invalid field's border. Intentional addition (the source shows no error state): derived from Red 2, darkened in Light to reach 4.5:1 on page; dark uses Red 2's light end (6:1+). Always paired with a message, never colour alone.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Data series 1 and the active bar (the blue bars in the price statistics).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Data series 2 (the purple bars in the navy statistics chart).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Data series 3 (violet completion marker).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Data series 4 (teal completion marker).

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive bars and empty tracks.

tokens.name: tg-primary-start
tokens.usage: Text Gradient Primary, first stop (top left). Large display text only.

tokens.name: tg-primary-end
tokens.usage: Text Gradient Primary, last stop (bottom right).

tokens.name: tg-secondary-start
tokens.usage: Text Gradient Secondary, first stop.

tokens.name: tg-secondary-mid
tokens.usage: Text Gradient Secondary, middle stop.

tokens.name: tg-secondary-end
tokens.usage: Text Gradient Secondary, last stop.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Embark on a creative journey as you learn.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Buttons, menu items, segmented options, names.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: invited you to a chat · 5m ago

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase tags and card eyebrows only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside tight controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; gap between stacked list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (md); row padding in menus.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; inner padding of compact cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Notification row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Standard card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutters and hero spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small buttons, duration badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The kit's default corner (Corner Radius: 10): buttons, inputs, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: App frames and large hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Search fields, segmented controls, toggles, avatars.

shadow.note: Elevation scale sm → xl plus glass, button, glow and inset treatments. Estimated from renders: the source shows elevation, not shadow values.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Elevation 1: tags, small pills, resting rows that need a hint of lift.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Elevation 2: hovered buttons and controls, the selected segment, dropdowns.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Elevation 3: hovered interactive cards, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Elevation 4: dialogs and the floating glass card over a busy screen.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed surfaces: slider and toggle tracks, pressed glass buttons, focused inputs.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass container: a top highlight plus a soft drop.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Glass buttons and the selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The Glow treatment: a blue halo under a primary or icon button. At most one per view.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: The coloured halo under the gradient Get Started button only.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-strong
tokens.usage: Hover state of a glowing button (glow prop, the + diamond, stepper plus).

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for every glass container.

tokens.name: blur-heavy
tokens.usage: Overlays and floating course cards over busy content.

tokens.name: gradient-blue-1
tokens.usage: Blue 1: deep indigo to blue; hero art, feature tiles.

tokens.name: gradient-blue-2
tokens.usage: Blue 2: blue to navy.

tokens.name: gradient-blue-3
tokens.usage: Blue 3: near-black navy; dark tiles.

tokens.name: gradient-light-blue-1
tokens.usage: Light Blue 1.

tokens.name: gradient-light-blue-2
tokens.usage: Light Blue 2: pale wash for light tiles.

tokens.name: gradient-red-1
tokens.usage: Red 1: red to plum.

tokens.name: gradient-red-2
tokens.usage: Red 2: coral.

tokens.name: gradient-red-3
tokens.usage: Red 3: peach through magenta to violet; the Get Started button.

tokens.name: gradient-yellow-1
tokens.usage: Yellow 1: amber.

tokens.name: gradient-learn
tokens.usage: The Learn call to action in course cards.

tokens.name: gradient-angular-1
tokens.usage: Angular Gradient 1: the Glow layer behind glass cards.

tokens.name: gradient-angular-2
tokens.usage: Angular Gradient 2.

tokens.name: gradient-angular-3
tokens.usage: Angular Gradient 3.

tokens.name: gradient-angular-4
tokens.usage: Angular Gradient 4.

duration.note: How long transitions and entrances take. All motion turns off under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and border changes, press feedback, tooltips.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Hover lifts, shadows, toggles, checks, segmented selection.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Card lifts, sheen sweeps, slider bubbles.

tokens.name: duration-enter
tokens.usage: Entrance of cards and list rows (bd-enter).

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default for hovers, colour and shadow changes.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances: things arriving on screen.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Small playful overshoot: toggle thumbs, check marks, the selected segment, icon-button presses.
